title: Lifestyle Enclave
lead: A new perspective on apartment living, surrounded by Nova Scotia’s natural landscape.
description: Lifestyle Enclave is a 102-unit residential community in Upper Hammonds Plains. Thoughtfully considered apartment layouts connect private living spaces with shared places to meet, unwind and feel at home.
detail: The community includes 48 one-bedroom plus den residences of approximately 780 square feet and 54 two-bedroom plus den residences of approximately 1,040 square feet. In-suite laundry, five-appliance kitchens and ducted heating and air conditioning are included. Shared amenities include a fitness centre, resident lounge, community room, meeting and multipurpose rooms, green spaces, a mailroom and two elevators. The official project site currently lists a planned move-in beginning in October 2026. Availability, pricing, parking, storage and timing remain subject to confirmation by the leasing team.
features: Green spaces, mailroom and two elevators
Surface parking and EV charging options
note: Renderings illustrate the architectural vision. Construction footage and photographs were published by the project without a stated capture date. Dimensions, pricing, inclusions, parking, storage, availability and move-in timing must be confirmed with the leasing team.

title: Two River, Mineville
lead: A planned community with nature, neighbourhood and everyday life at its heart.
description: Also introduced as Notting Hill, Two River is a planned 73-acre residential community in Mineville. The concept includes 54 fourplex lots and 216 residential units.
detail: The illustrative master plan describes a low-density community organized around green space and walking routes, with access to Highway 107 and Dartmouth. Proposed shared amenities include a central park, clubhouse, community gardens, pocket parks, nature trails, a dog park, a playground and water features. The plan illustrates fourplex homes of approximately 3,000 to 3,500 square feet with four bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, double-car garages, private gardens and decks or patios.
features: Private garden with deck or patio
note: Illustrative concept master plan. Density, zoning, lot sizes, home dimensions, amenities, layouts and unit counts are proposed, unverified and subject to change. Confirm all planning and sales information directly with Plexus.

title: Cornwallis Park
lead: A long-term vision for land, local opportunity and connected growth.
description: Positioned between Digby and Annapolis Royal, Cornwallis Park is presented as a 240-acre land parcel with potential for phased residential, commercial and complementary uses.
detail: The earlier concept plan identifies 121 Normandy Road, Cornwallis Park, PID 05268909, and illustrates multi-unit residential, townhomes, a commercial plaza, a warehouse facility, park space and trails. The surrounding strategy describes mostly level land with treed sections and existing road access. The address, parcel identifier, land area, access and every proposed use require current title, survey and planning confirmation before they are treated as fact.

Commercial possibilities: Retail plaza and grocery or essential services
Landscape and energy: Long-term land-banking or phased mixed-use planning

note: Illustrative concept only. The official Cornwallis Park Secondary Planning Strategy is effective March 27, 2025 and was amended June 8, 2026. Parcel-specific zoning, ownership, the address, PID, acreage, access and all proposed uses require direct confirmation before publication or development decisions.
